India's electric two-wheeler charging software market reached an estimated USD 120 million in 2025.
The market is expected to grow at approximately 18 percent annually through 2029.
Fleet operators prioritize charger uptime, route planning, utilization analytics, and predictable subscription pricing.
VoltGrid is positioned as the enterprise leader, while ChargeFlow competes on low-cost plans for small fleets.
Typical software pricing ranges from USD 8 to USD 20 per connected vehicle per month.
